parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (internally compensated for linear feedback) and comparators (uncompensated open-loop switching) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
A part wins only if its recommended Vs range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.
Multiply by channel count for total IC standby current draw.
RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.
Winner requires superiority on both CMRR (higher) and input voltage noise (lower); mixed tradeoffs stay CONTEXT.
Important when driving heavy resistive loads or high supply rails.

swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: TLV9062IDR is limited to 5.5 V max (6 V abs max, p.10) whereas LM358DR supports up to 30 V (32 V abs max, p.4). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LM358DR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR vs TLV9062IDR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 14.3x (LM358DR: 0.7 MHz p.10 vs TLV9062IDR: 10 MHz p.13); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 21.7x (LM358DR: 0.3 V/µs p.10 vs TLV9062IDR: 6.5 V/µs p.13); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 40000x (LM358DR: 20000 pA p.10 vs TLV9062IDR: 0.5 pA p.13); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TLV9062IDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (6 V, p.10) than LM358DR (32 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 26% higher on TLV9062IDR (LM358DR: 124.7 °C/W p.5 vs TLV9062IDR: 157.6 °C/W p.11); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM358DR requires Vs,min >= 3 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM358DR: 0..70 °C Commercial (0°C to 70°C) vs TLV9062IDR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 125°C)); LM358DR cold limit only 0 °C, LM358DR hot limit only 70 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM358DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and TLV9062IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; GBWP differs 14.3x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 0.7 MHz (p.10) vs 10 MHz (p.13), supply ceiling 30 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.10), Vos 7 mV (p.10) vs 1.6 mV (p.13), Ib 40000x gap (20000 vs 0.5 pA), voltage noise 40 vs 16 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM358DR "Non-Rail-to-Rail Upper Input and Output Headroom Ceiling" (p.10) and TLV9062IDR "6.0 V Absolute Maximum Supply Limit — Destructive in 12 V / 24 V LM358 or TL072 SOIC-8 Sockets" (p.10). BOM decision: Choose LM358DR when supply rails exceed 5.5 V (rated up to 30 V); choose TLV9062IDR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 10 MHz GBWP or DC precision demands <= 1.6 mV max Vos. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.6) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
